## Line 242

```plato

    //==
    // # Bend constraints — the dihedral projection
    //
    // A distance constraint two vertices apart resists folding only along one
    // axis and stiffens stretching as a side effect. The dihedral constraint
    // instead names the angle between the two triangles sharing an edge and
    // drives it toward `RestAngle`, which leaves stretching alone.
    //
    // Numbering follows `ClothBendConstraint`: VertexA and VertexB are the
    // shared edge, VertexC and VertexD the two wings. The normals are taken as
    // edge x wing from VertexA, so a FLAT pair — wings on opposite sides of the
    // edge — has the two normals opposed and a dihedral angle of pi. Rest
    // angles built from geometry (`ClothFromMesh`, below) carry that
    // automatically.
    // (Müller et al., Position Based Dynamics, 2007, §4.)

    // The unit normal of the triangle spanned by the shared edge and one wing,
    // both expressed as displacements from VertexA. Zero for a degenerate
    // triangle, which then contributes nothing.
    BendNormal(edge: Vector3D, wing: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => edge.Cross(wing).NormalizeOr(Vector3D.Zero);
```
